name: panama-tech-compliance
description: Verify and implement compliance with Panamanian technology law — Ley 81 (datos personales/ANTAI), Ley 51 (firma electrónica), factura electrónica (SFEP/DGI), Ley 45 (ACODECO), plus fintech, health, public-sector and accessibility regimes. Audits code, emits a trámite checklist for what code can't satisfy.
